title: Pastor Omoding Cares for All
subtitle: Working Fathers of Soroti
author: Anthony Mwesigwa
description: Follow Pastor Omoding as he shepherds his church and cares for all the families of Soroti.
keywords: pastor, church, minister, Uganda, Soroti, family, work, father, faith, community
dedication: For all the pastors who shepherd God's people with love and faithfulness.
authorBio: Anthony Mwesigwa is a passionate storyteller from Kampala, Uganda, dedicated to creating engaging educational books for young African readers.
backCoverText: Who cares for the whole community? Join Pastor Omoding as he preaches, prays, visits, and loves the people of Soroti. The final story in the series, bringing all the families together.
